Forms are removed when remove_forms is true

```zig title="Zig"
const std = @import("std");
const html_to_markdown_rs = @import("html_to_markdown_rs");

pub fn main() !void {
    const _result_json = try html_to_markdown_rs.convert("<p>Before</p><form><input type='text'/><button>Submit</button></form><p>After</p>", "{\"preprocessing\":{\"remove_forms\":true}}");
    defer std.heap.c_allocator.free(_result_json);
    std.debug.print("{s}\n", .{_result_json});

}
```
